description: Node entry classification (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §2, §5, §6): a single content string is classified before formula parsing — '' = Empty, leading = is a formula, leading ' forces text, a finite number = number, TRUE/FALSE (case-insensitive) = logical, a quoted string = text, anything else = verbatim text. Adopts OxFml §2.1A (see HANDOVER_OXFML_constant_input). Number constants carry an Excel-aligned implicit number_format; exact values for dates are Excel-anchored.

cases.name: empty string is the Empty value
cases.note: The one TreeCalc-specific addition to §2.1A; a formula cannot produce top-level Empty.

cases.name: percent entry infers value and format
currency entry infers value and format
date entry parses to a serial with a date format
cases.note: Date text parses to an Excel date serial; the exact serial is Excel-anchored.

cases.name: a bare word is text, not a reference
cases.note: Without a leading =, Margin is the text "Margin"; only =Margin is a reference (Excel cell-entry convention).

cases.name: apostrophe forces text on a number-like entry
cases.note: The leading apostrophe is an entry escape, not part of the value.

cases.name: leading = is a formula, not a constant
cases.note: Classification distinguishes formula from constant; the formula then parses/evaluates normally.
